consequence.statement: This is a new opt-in option. Annotation keys are copied from Ingress-like objects to the resulting Certificate only when an operator sets the option.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds the ingress-shim option `--extra-certificate-annotations`, which sets a list of annotation keys to copy from Ingress-like objects to the Certificate objects created from them.
